answer: Because the timing is recorded against the wander challenge, the orchard audit can replay the haven history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 56 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4364 identities would post 979 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
